hero.title: About Us
hero.description: We're a passionate team of travel enthusiasts dedicated to creating unforgettable journeys. Since our founding, we've helped thousands of travelers discover the world's most incredible destinations.

collective.title: Our Collective Journey
collective.description: From humble beginnings to becoming a trusted name in travel, our journey has been shaped by our commitment to excellence, sustainability, and creating meaningful connections between travelers and destinations.

items.description: SCAPIA was founded with a vision to make extraordinary travel accessible to everyone.
Expanded our destinations to cover all seven continents, reaching remote and unique locations.
Launched our sustainable travel initiative, committing to eco-friendly tourism practices.
Adapted to new travel realities, introducing flexible booking and virtual experiences.
Celebrating 15 years of creating unforgettable memories for travelers worldwide.

whyChoose.title: Why Choose SCAPIA
whyChoose.subtitle: We go above and beyond to ensure every journey exceeds your expectations.

team.title: Meet Our Team
team.subtitle: The passionate people behind your extraordinary travel experiences.
